subject: Is the stepwiseqtl function apply to haploid?

messages.author: 49a67c6e0f03dace
messages.subject: Is the stepwiseqtl function apply to haploid?
parts:
Hello Karl,

I'm working on a haploid fungi, and I saw more than one QTLs on the same chromosome after my interval mapping. So my questions are :

(1) Can I apply the 'stepwiseqtl' function to the genotype data of a haploid cross?

(2) What about the MQM analysis on haploid?

What is your opinion?

Thanks a lot!

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Is the stepwiseqtl function apply to haploid?
parts:
Yes, stepwiseqtl will apply; the mqm functions could as well, because haploids can be treated the same as a backcross.

karl
